title: 1956 All India Radio Belgaum/Dharwad Special Broadcast: Karnataka Ekikarana (Unification)

transcript_segments.speaker: AIR Announcer (Kannada)
transcript_segments.native_text: ಆಕಾಶವಾಣಿ ಧಾರವಾಡ-ಬೆಳಗಾವಿ ಕೇಂದ್ರ. ಇಂದು ನವೆಂಬರ್ ಒಂದು, ಸಾವಿರದ ಒಂಬೈನೂರ ಐವತ್ತಾರು.
transcript_segments.english_translation: All India Radio Dharwad-Belagavi Station. Today is November 1st, 1956.

transcript_segments.speaker: Special Correspondent (Kannada/English)
transcript_segments.native_text: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಏಕೀಕರಣದ ಈ ಐತಿಹಾಸಿಕ ಕ್ಷಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಳಗಾವಿಯ ಶಹಾಪುರ ಮತ್ತು ವಡಗಾವಿ ಬೀದಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಜನಸಾಗರವೇ ಸೇರಿದೆ.
transcript_segments.english_translation: In this historic moment of Karnataka Unification, crowds have gathered across Shahapur and Vadgaon streets in Belagavi.

transcript_segments.speaker: Archival Commentary (English)
transcript_segments.native_text: Under the States Reorganisation Act, the Kannada-speaking regions unite into a single heritage state.
transcript_segments.english_translation: Under the States Reorganisation Act, the Kannada-speaking regions unite into a single heritage state.

title: 1968 North Karnataka Suggi Kunitha & Halakki Folk Bhajan Field Recording

transcript_segments.speaker: Lead Folk Singer (Kannada)
transcript_segments.native_text: ಸುಗ್ಗಿ ಬಂತು ಸುಗ್ಗಿ, ಉತ್ತರ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಭೂಮಿ ತಾಯಿಗೆ ನಮನ.
transcript_segments.english_translation: The harvest festival (Suggi) has arrived; salutations to Mother Earth of North Karnataka.

transcript_segments.speaker: Chorus (Hindi / Deccani Bhajan)
transcript_segments.native_text: माटी के गीत गाओ रे साथी, सह्याद्री के आँगन में ढोल बाजे।
transcript_segments.english_translation: Sing the songs of the soil, O companions; the drums echo in the courtyard of the Sahyadri hills.

transcript_segments.speaker: Ethnomusicologist Field Note (English)
transcript_segments.native_text: Recorded in Khanapur taluk, Belagavi district, featuring traditional Gumate and Halgi percussion.
transcript_segments.english_translation: Recorded in Khanapur taluk, Belagavi district, featuring traditional Gumate and Halgi percussion.

gemma_catalog.historical_summary: Multilingual agrarian harvest song blending Kannada Suggi Kunitha poetry with Hindi/Deccani devotional verse, accompanied by indigenous Gumate and Halgi percussion in Khanapur, Belagavi.
